title: Nhận định trận ra quân World Cup 2026 giữa Canada và Bosnia

scenes.subjectHint: Alphonso Davies so tài Edin Džeko
scenes.prompt: Vertical 9:16 split-frame football poster artwork showing a 2026 FIFA World Cup group stage matchup between Canada and Bosnia & Herzegovina. Left half: Alphonso Davies, the Canadian left-back, in the red Canada home kit with the Canada Soccer maple-leaf crest visible, dynamic sprinting pose. Behind him, a vibrant red-and-white Canada graphic backdrop with a huge faint Canada Maple Leaf crest watermark and radiating light rays. Right half: Edin Džeko, the veteran Bosnian striker, in the blue Bosnia & Herzegovina home kit with the NFSBIH crest visible, intense focused hero pose. Behind him, a blue-and-yellow graphic backdrop with a huge faint Bosnia crest watermark. Down the centre seam: a diagonal glowing lightning-burst separator, with the 2026 World Cup trophy rendered as a stylized graphic accent in the middle. Saturated vibrant color palette, very high contrast, glossy graphic finish. Both crests visible on jerseys, no on-image text.
